pause_reason: No replay of old messages. Cross-border sender obligations, recipient entity or consent, contact purpose and privacy information must be documented before a new send.
rates_note: Planning equivalents only, not a verified live exchange rate. Invoice currency and rate are agreed in writing.
hosting: Client-owned account, paid by client; no hosting subscription bundled in the project fee.

licence.name: DIY template licence
licence.scope: Template files only; self-installation. No custom content, setup, translation or ongoing service.

baguette.name: Baguette — one useful page
baguette.scope: One responsive page in one language: menu or visit/collection information and a link to an existing order route. Client supplies final text, hours, prices and images. One revision round.
deliverables: One clear link to an existing order or contact route
An editable content file and handover notes

croissant.name: Croissant — two clear pages
croissant.scope: Two responsive pages in one language: a menu and a visit/collection page for one location or a simple location list. Existing checkout stays unchanged. Client-supplied text and images. One revision round.

patisserie.name: Pâtisserie — three-page enquiry site
patisserie.scope: Up to three template-based pages in one language, with a simple request form handing details to the business by email. Requests are not confirmed orders. Existing checkout remains unchanged. Client-supplied text and images. One revision round.
deliverables: A simple enquiry or collection-request form

excluded_by_default: Payment processing or a new checkout
Inventory, confirmed order slots or delivery integrations
Multiple custom location sites or a custom CMS
Hosting, domains, subscriptions or ongoing care

US.reason: User excludes commercial-email markets requiring a valid postal address; no location-free workaround.

CA.reason: Mailing-address and CASL requirements are incompatible with this campaign's no-address instruction.

GB.requires: Documented corporate-subscriber status or appropriate prior consent, relevant contact purpose, identity and privacy review.

FR.requires: Documented professional relevance, source, information/objection and privacy review, or appropriate consent. No blanket EU exemption.

ES.requires: Documented prior authorisation or a reviewed applicable exception. A public email is not sufficient.

rules: No city, country, nationality or substitute location in marketing signatures.
Keep the real sender identity and working reply address; never use a fake local company, address or phone.
Required billing, contractual, tax or payment/KYC details must be truthful; decline the transaction if required details will not be disclosed.
If a prospect makes disclosure of provider locality a condition and the user declines, exclude that prospect permanently; do not invent an answer.
An address published for hiring, merchandise preorders or another narrow purpose is not a general vendor-proposal inbox.
No sender-country assumption and no guarantee that excluding a recipient country removes all sender-side legal obligations.
Old delivered messages cannot be edited or recalled. New drafts are neither backdated replacements nor automatic follow-ups.
No new send until the suppression and legal gates pass. A prior recipient requires separate follow-up approval.
No tax-free, no-VAT or guaranteed-legality claim in marketing or generated quotes.
